title: Cade Marlowe 2024 Topps Series 1 Baseball #286 RC Rookie Seattle Mariners
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2024 Topps Series 1 baseball trading card featuring Cade Marlowe of the Seattle Mariners. The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 20 pt. It is an original licensed reprint and part of the base set, with a card number of 286. 

This card is a great addition to any Major League Baseball (MLB) fan's collection. It is a rookie card and also features Marlowe in a parallel/variety insert. The card is in English and manufactured by Topps in the United States. It is not autographed and is not vintage.
